residual_risks: The OPA policy seeded here (package ocor.bootstrap, default allow = false) is a fail-closed placeholder establishing a safe initial state, not real authorization logic; authoring the actual OCOR policy is WS-11 scope (OCOR-DEV-0048 and later), not this WS-12 infrastructure-bootstrap task.
The Keycloak realm created here is an empty shell (enabled, no clients/roles/users); populating it with real OCOR clients and roles is also WS-11 scope.
TerminusDB/TypeDB database creation here provisions empty databases with no schema; schema definition is C4 projection-adapter scope (OCOR-DEV-0037/0038), not yet implemented.
The same pre-existing local-venv gap noted in OCOR-DEV-0079's evidence (no psycopg installed) is unchanged by this task and is out of its scope.
rollback_procedure_verified: RUN 3/RUN 4 above constitute a real, executed rollback drill: an externally introduced drift was detected and rejected without mutation (RUN 3), then the correct state was restored and full PASS reconfirmed (RUN 4) -- proving the fail-closed contract, not just describing it.
